text: I'm so sorry to message this late, I know you must be busy with much worse than this. I've got my grandson Ollie staying, he's 4. His temperature is 39.7, I checked it twice. He's had runny poos this evening, three or four times. He was sick once around tea time but he's kept everything down since, he's been drinking his squash fine, little sips and big gulps. He's still going to the toilet for wees like normal so I don't think he's drying out, that bit seems ok. I just get in a state when they're hot like that and his mum's away till Sunday. Sorry again for bothering you
